scoring_justification: The on-axis temperature change can be recomputed from the public parameters using the analytical formula; checker recomputes expected value and compares agent's result within tolerance.

schema.description: A single decimal number representing the on-axis temperature change ΔT(0) in Kelvin, with at least 4 decimal places.

outputs.description: The computed on-axis temperature change ΔT(0) from the analytical heat equation model.

output_contract.notes: Only the on-axis temperature change is scored; the rest of the paper's workflow (refractive index profile, diffraction simulations, interferometric data processing) is omitted because the thermo-optic coefficient dn/dT is not provided in the paper.
